# Endwise

> Endwise: exact answers for specific jobs, paid per use from one prepaid balance, on the web, over a REST API or through MCP.

Endwise is a Conyso product. Every tool is deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer, with no AI model in the loop. Each content page has a Markdown copy at the same address ending in .md.

## Using Endwise

- [Guides](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/): Every guide: using the tools from AI assistants, editors, spreadsheets and automations, building an agent, checking AI numbers, and paying per use.
- [How to use Endwise with Claude (Claude apps and Claude Code)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/use-with-claude/): Add Endwise as a custom connector, sign in and approve it with a monthly limit, try a first prompt, and keep spend under control.
- [How to use Endwise with ChatGPT](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/use-with-chatgpt/): Add Endwise to ChatGPT as a custom MCP server, sign in and approve it with a monthly limit, and call the same tools from the OpenAI API.
- [How to add Endwise to Cursor and VS Code (MCP)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/use-in-cursor-and-vs-code/): Exact mcp.json files for Cursor and VS Code with a Bearer key, how to keep keys out of git, and how to check it works.
- [Give your own AI agent exact tools: 3 ways](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/build-an-agent/): For developers: three ways to give an agent exact tools (Anthropic MCP connector, OpenAI remote MCP, REST function calling), with samples, per-agent keys, quotes and error handling.
- [Use Endwise in Google Sheets: custom functions with Apps Script](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/google-sheets/): Apps Script code for Sheets: custom functions, a menu command that writes values, the API key kept in script properties, and no double charges on recalculation.
- [Use Endwise in Excel with Power Query (POST with a JSON body)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/excel/): Power Query M code for Excel: a POST with a Bearer header and Json.FromValue body, a reusable function for table rows, and how to avoid paying again on refresh.
- [Use Endwise in Zapier, Make and n8n (one HTTP step)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/zapier-make-n8n/): One HTTP step in Zapier (Webhooks), Make (HTTP) and n8n (HTTP Request): URL, Authorization header, JSON body, result mapping and retry safety.
- [Why AI assistants get dates and numbers wrong](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/why-ai-gets-numbers-wrong/): Why language models miss on dates, holidays, rates and tax figures, shown with worked cases, and how to give an assistant a tool that gets them exactly.
- [How to check a number an AI gives you](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/check-numbers-from-ai/): A short procedure for checking a date, rate or tax figure from an AI assistant, with what to test for each kind of number.
- [Pay per use or a subscription: which costs less](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/pay-per-use-or-subscription/): The break-even formula for pay per use against a subscription, worked with Endwise prices: when per use wins and when a pass wins.
- [A spreadsheet or Endwise: which to use](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/spreadsheet-or-endwise/): An honest comparison of a spreadsheet and Endwise for business days, exchange rates, mileage, per diem and 1099 thresholds, including when the spreadsheet wins.

## Tools

- [1099-K reconciliation](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-k-reconciliation/): Walks Form 1099-K Box 1a down to your books: personal payments, duplicates, sales tax and personal items out, refunds and chargebacks to Schedule C line 2, fees to line 10, Boxes 5a to 5l month by month, the $20,000 and 200-transaction check, and a CPA worksheet, each line cited to the IRS.
- [1099 threshold tracker](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/): Check which payees need a Form 1099-NEC or 1099-MISC for a payment year, in which box and why: the $2,000 line for 2026 payments, $600 for 2025, royalties at $10 and attorney gross proceeds at $600, with the corporation, card and merchandise exceptions, backup withholding, payees merged by TIN, due dates and an IRIS upload file.
- [Amazon Error 8572 checker](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/amazon-error-8572-checker/): Check UPCs, EANs and GTINs before an Amazon upload, or after Error 8572: the GS1 check digit, the GS1 Prefix, whether each code is inside the company prefix on your GS1 certificate, and whether the brand you list matches the GS1 licensee name you give it, with the documents Amazon's Error 8572 help asks for and a letter of affiliation built to its checks. It does not look up GS1 records.
- [Amazon low-inventory-level fee and reorder planner](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/amazon-low-inventory-fee-calculator/): Check per FBA SKU whether Amazon's low-inventory-level fee applies this week, at which rate (Amazon's 2026 rule and the 2027 rule from February 1, 2027, by size tier and weight, with every listed exemption), and plan the reorder: the send-by and order-by dates and units to send that keep stock at 28 or more days of supply, given prep, transit and receiving days, and what a late shipment costs.
- [Amazon settlement reconciliation](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/amazon-settlement-reconciliation/): Upload an Amazon Flat File V2 settlement report and see its rows proved against total-amount, the total tied to the bank deposit, and the settlement split at month end by posted date, with sales, fees, refunds, tax and reserve on their own lines and a balanced journal per month for QuickBooks Online or Xero.
- [Amazon title checker](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/amazon-title-checker/): Check every Amazon product title in a file, a listings report or a pasted list against the rules Amazon published: 75 characters including spaces outside media since July 27, 2026, the banned characters ! $ ? \_ { } ^ ¬ ¦ outside the brand name, and no word more than twice. Each title gets its count, what to fix, where a cut to 75 falls and the overflow for Item Highlights (125), plus a fix list CSV.
- [Amortization schedule to journal entries](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/amortization-schedule-journal-entries/): Turns prepaid expenses, deferred revenue, loans and loan fees into balanced monthly journal entries: straight-line by equal months, half-months or actual days with the rounding in the last month, loan payments split into interest and principal, cancellations, a rollforward that ties to the GL and a 12-month rule check, as a QuickBooks Online or Xero import file.
- [Bank-feed duplicate finder for QuickBooks Online and Xero](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/bank-feed-duplicate-finder/): Upload the bank-feed lines and the register (or Xero statement lines and Account Transactions) for one account: every pair of the same amount within N days is listed, in the feed twice, in the books twice or a feed line already entered by hand, with a confidence, which copy to keep (the reconciled one first) and the exact action in QuickBooks Online or Xero, as an exclude-ready CSV. Never changes your books.
- [Bank reconciliation difference finder](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/bank-reconciliation-difference-finder/): Compare a bank statement CSV with the ledger for the same account (QuickBooks Online, Xero or any CSV): the difference at the statement date, every line on one side only, timing items (outstanding checks, deposits in transit) set apart from likely errors (digit transpositions, slides, sign flips, duplicates, bank lines missing from the books), the date the running balance broke, and a reconciliation statement. Never changes your books.
- [Bulk certificate generator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/bulk-certificate-generator/): Turn a class or attendee list (CSV, Excel or rows) into one printable certificate per name in one PDF, on US Letter or A4, in seven designs (achievement, completion, appreciation, end-of-year award, funny award, kids, participation), with each name fitted to its line, per-row award titles and hours, names cleaned and repeats found, a free plan and a free watermarked proof; the list is used in memory and not kept.
- [Bulk sender check](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/bulk-sender-check/): Grade one raw email (.eml) against Gmail's, Yahoo's and Microsoft Outlook.com's bulk-sender rules: SPF, DKIM (verified, with key length), DMARC record and alignment, RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe, reverse DNS, TLS and RFC 5322 format, each rule quoted from the provider with its source.
- [Business days](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/): Count the business days between two dates, or add business days to a date, for US federal, England and Wales, or India central government holidays. US holidays are the statutory federal ones only, with no executive-order closures. India ("IN-CENTRAL-DELHI") is the closed (gazetted) holidays of central government offices in Delhi and New Delhi from the Department of Personnel and Training's yearly list, 2025 to 2027 only: not restricted holidays, not any state's list and not bank holidays. Add your own days off to skip them too.
- [Chargeback evidence packet builder](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/chargeback-evidence/): For a chargeback on Stripe, Shopify Payments or PayPal: what the reason code means (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover or PayPal), the evidence that answers it strongest first and which upload slot each piece goes in; then the response packet itself, a rebuttal letter and one labelled exhibit PDF per evidence type built from your screenshots, checked against the platform's size, page and file limits. Also the fees and the break-even win chance, days left to the due date with a calendar file, and Visa Compelling Evidence 3.0 eligibility. Files are processed in memory and not kept. Not legal advice; the card issuer decides.
- [Cleaning bid calculator (commercial and post-construction)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/cleaning-bid-calculator/): Turn a building walk-through into a cleaning bid: square feet at your own production rates, restroom fixtures and glass panes at your own minutes each, a loaded wage built from BLS May 2025 wages and IRS 2026 payroll taxes, supplies, overhead and margin, priced per visit and month (janitorial) or per rough, final and touch-up phase (post-construction), with a $/sq ft check and a proposal PDF.
- [Clearing account cleanup: aging and exact deposit matches](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/clearing-account-cleanup/): Upload an Undeposited Funds, suspense or Ask My Accountant export (QuickBooks Online or Xero): see every open item aged 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days after what already nets off inside the account, and every set of open payments that adds up to each bank deposit to the cent, with fee-netted candidates listed apart. Lists matches; never posts to your books.
- [Cron expression checker and next run times](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/cron/): Explain a cron expression in plain English and list its next run times in any IANA time zone, with each scheduler's own daylight saving rule; check it against the dialect of Linux crontab, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, Vercel, n8n, Quartz, Spring, UiPath or AWS EventBridge, and write the same schedule for each of the others.
- [Natural-language date resolver](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/date-resolver/): Turn a phrase such as "90 days from today", "10 business days after next Friday" or "end of next month" into one exact calendar date with its weekday, from an explicit reference date. Business days skip weekends and US federal, England and Wales or India central government holidays, and every holiday skipped is named. Ambiguous phrases ("next Friday") return both readings. Call it instead of doing date arithmetic yourself.
- [Delivery date and holiday order-by calculator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/delivery-date-calculator/): Work out when an order arrives, or the last day to order for delivery by a date such as Christmas, from your cutoff time, time zone, shipping days, closures and processing days, on the carrier's own delivery calendar, with USPS's 2026 holiday send-by dates and every skipped holiday named.
- [DMARC report analyzer](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/dmarc-report-analyzer/): Read a DMARC aggregate report (.xml, .gz, .zip or the .eml it came in, RFC 9990 or RFC 7489) and see which named service sent as your domain, which one fails DMARC and why, with the fix; reports are read in memory and not kept.
- [Donor acknowledgment letters](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/donor-acknowledgment-letter/): Turn a list of gifts (CSV or a list) into one thank-you letter per gift with the right IRS Publication 1771 wording for each: the no-goods-or-services or intangible religious benefits sentence for money, a good faith estimate and the $75 disclosure for a ticket, a description without a value for goods and stock, a no-receipt thank-you for a donor-advised fund grant, a pledge confirmation, a volunteer thank-you, and a notice to a memorial family without the amount; segments (first, repeat, lapsed, major, monthly) choose the opening line. PDFs per letter, a print file, the letter texts and CSVs.
- [eBay transaction report flattener](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/ebay-transaction-report-flattener/): Upload an eBay transaction report CSV and get one row per sale: item, gross, shipping charged, every fee column by name, the shipping label and ad-fee rows folded in by order number, refunds and claims, and what you kept, with totals by year and month, proved to the cent against eBay's Net amount.
- [FBA prep checker](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fba-prep-checker/): Tell it what an Amazon FBA product is (category, size, weight, liquid container, bag) and get the prep Amazon's US Seller Central pages require, step by step with each page linked: poly bag, bubble wrap, box, cap seal, opaque bag, set label, the suffocation warning and its print size, FNSKU or manufacturer barcode, the expiration-date label and the 2026 and 2027 size tier; check a whole shipment list, and print FNSKU, warning, "Sold as set" and expiration labels as PDFs.
- [Refunded but never returned: FBA customer return reimbursement checker](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fba-refund-not-returned/): Upload Amazon's refunds (Date Range Transaction or settlement report), FBA Customer Returns and Reimbursements reports and see which refunded FBA orders were neither returned nor reimbursed, or reimbursed below the refund, each with the claim window from Amazon's help page for the marketplace (US: days 60 to 120 after the refund), the case text and a CSV.
- [Final paycheck deadline by state](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/final-paycheck-deadline/): The date (and time, where the law counts hours) a final paycheck is due when an employee is fired, laid off or quits, for the states whose own statute or labor department pages we have read, computed from the separation date, notice, pay schedule and business days; whether a deduction for unreturned equipment, an advance or negative PTO, a shortage or an overpayment is allowed, with the minimum-wage floor check; and the late-pay penalty where the state sets a formula. Every rule is quoted from the state's own site with the date read; other states are listed as not covered.
- [Fix a CSV export (leading zeros, dates, encoding) with a saved recipe](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fix-csv-export/): Upload the CSV export you fix every month: get back leading zeros on ZIP codes and account codes, DD/MM vs MM/DD settled per column with the values that prove it (ambiguous dates listed, never guessed), long IDs kept as text, garbled accents repaired and UTF-8 with or without a BOM, plus a saved recipe that applies the same fix to next month's file and warns when its columns change.
- [FMLA eligibility checker](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fmla-eligibility-checker/): Check FMLA eligibility under 29 CFR 825.110: 12 months of employment (with the seven-year break rule for rehires), 1,250 hours in the 12 months before leave, and 50 employees within 75 surface miles of the worksite, where a remote worker's worksite is the office they report to. Gives the reason the eligibility notice must state and its five-business-day due date, the hours in 12 or 26 workweeks for any schedule, and the leave balance under the rolling, calendar-year, fixed-year or measured-forward method with the days leave comes back.
- [State family and medical leave overlay](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fmla-state-leave-overlay/): For one employee's leave in one state (employer size, hire date, hours, reason, start date), lists the state family and medical leave laws that apply alongside the federal FMLA, how each runs with it, and the total weeks of job-protected and state-paid leave, including a birth parent's pregnancy disability followed by bonding. Every state rule is quoted from the state's own site with the date read; states we could not read are named as not covered. Federal eligibility comes from the FMLA eligibility checker. Not legal advice.
- [Exchange rate on a date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/): The official rate for a currency pair on a date, with the date or period actually used. By default the ECB euro reference rate (the latest fixing in the 7 days up to the date, and which); or, with source, the US Treasury reporting rate, the IRS yearly average or the HMRC monthly rate, each named with the publication it came from.
- [Wage garnishment calculator for employers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/garnishment-calculator/): For one paycheck: disposable earnings from the pay stub, the federal CCPA limit and the work state's own limit (from its statute, for the states covered), the lesser of the two, what is left for a creditor after child support and earlier orders, support and federal-debt limits, the IRS levy exempt amount from Publication 1494, and the numbers for the answer form.
- [Good Faith Estimate generator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/good-faith-estimate-generator/): A No Surprises Act Good Faith Estimate for an uninsured or self-pay patient (45 CFR 149.610), laid out like the CMS model notice: the date it is due in business days, a recurring course of care turned into dated sessions within 12 months, lines and totals for each provider or facility, the four required disclaimers, every required element checked, and a PDF. Patient details are not kept. Not legal advice.
- [GPSR listing checker](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/gpsr-listing-checker/): Check every SKU in an Amazon, Etsy, eBay, Shopify or plain CSV export against the four items Article 19 of the EU General Product Safety Regulation (EU) 2023/988 says an online offer must show: the manufacturer, the EU responsible person when the manufacturer is outside the EU, the product's picture, type and identifier, and warnings in a language of each market. Get a per-SKU fix list, a checklist CSV and a label block per SKU, each finding cited to its article.
- [Hours calculator and timesheet](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/hours-calculator/): Add up clock-in and clock-out times minus unpaid breaks, including overnight and split shifts and daylight-saving nights, split overtime by fixed workweek (over 40 hours, plus optional daily thresholds), check what time-clock rounding did to the punches under 29 CFR 785.48, convert hours and minutes to decimal, and make a signable timesheet PDF.
- [US import duty estimator by HTS code](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/hts-duty-estimator/): Estimate the US import duty on one SKU or a whole product list from its HTS code, country of origin and value: the base rate from the USITC schedule plus each Section 301 layer by origin, each with its legal source and date, refusing any layer not verified; plus MPF and HMF for a shipment and a check of which products are missing an HTS code, origin or weight.
- [IFTA quarterly return calculator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/ifta-calculator/): Work out an IFTA quarterly return per jurisdiction and fuel at the quarter's final matrix rates, surcharges included, from totals or from trip sheets and fuel receipts, with an odometer reconciliation across trips and a check of every record against the IFTA distance and fuel record elements.
- [Image to size](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/image-to-size/): Shrink a photo to fit under an exact size in KB, such as 50 KB or 200 KB, for upload forms that set a limit. It runs in your browser, so the photo never leaves your device.
- [Inbound placement fee calculator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/inbound-placement-fee-calculator/): Which Amazon FBA inbound placement option is cheapest for a shipment once your freight is in: minimal, partial or Amazon-optimized splits, priced from Amazon's own US fee table by size tier and weight, with the break-even fee, the five-identical-carton check for Amazon-optimized splits, the day the fee is charged, and AWD as the alternative.
- [HS, HTS, NAICS and SIC code checker](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/industry-code-lookup/): Check HS, US HTS, Schedule B, NAICS, US and UK SIC and IRS Schedule C codes against the official tables, one or 5,000 at a time: valid or not, the official title, the table's edition and date, NAICS 2017 codes that were replaced, SBA size standards and the proposed NAICS 2027 changes; or search the official index for the codes that contain your words.
- [Landed cost allocator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/landed-cost-allocator/): Spread a shipment's freight, duty, broker and other invoices across its PO lines by value, weight, CBM, units, per line, as given or a mix, and get the landed cost per unit of every SKU, with each invoice split to the cent and added back exactly; re-cost only the units still on hand when an invoice comes late, and fill Cost per item in your own Shopify product export.
- [Rent late fee checker and late notice](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/late-fee-checker/): The most a landlord may lawfully charge as a rent late fee in a state, from which day, and whether a proposed fee (flat, percent or daily) is within the statute, each rule quoted from the statute with its source and reading date; plus a late rent notice PDF with the fee checked. Covered: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Chicago's ordinance; other states are refused until their statute is read. Not legal advice.
- [Late payment interest calculator and claim letter](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/late-payment-interest/): The statutory interest and fixed compensation you can claim on a late business invoice: UK Late Payment Act (8% over the Bank Rate on the reference date, £40, £70 or £100), Ireland, Germany (§ 288 BGB) and the EU directive minimum by half-year, the US federal Prompt Payment Act, Texas and Florida public bodies, or your own terms; each rate dated and sourced. Plus a claim letter and interest invoice PDF, and many invoices at once from a CSV. Business debts only; not legal advice.
- [Lien deadline calculator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/lien-deadline/): The last day to send the preliminary notice, record the lien and sue to enforce it, for your state, role and project, worked out from your furnishing and completion dates, with each date quoted from the state's own statute and the day it was read; what a late notice still protects; the Texas month-by-month notice dates; the federal Miller Act bond claim dates; and the state's statutory notice filled in as a PDF with a proof-of-service log. States whose own statute site we could not read are listed as not covered. Not legal advice.
- [Lien waiver generator by state](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/lien-waiver/): Pick the lien waiver a payment needs from the state and whether you have been paid, then fill in that state's statutory form word for word from the official statute (Arizona, California, Florida, Texas with its pre-2022 notarized version, Wyoming), with a hard stop on unconditional waivers before the money clears and the matching unconditional free for the same payment.
- [MACRS depreciation schedule](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/macrs-depreciation/): Paste a client's fixed-asset additions for 2025 or 2026 and get the IRS percentage-table schedule: the mid-quarter 40% test across every asset with the worksheet, Section 179 within the year's limit and phase-out, the special allowance by acquisition date (100% after January 19, 2025), each number tied to its Publication 946 table, and the journal entry as a CSV.
- [Mileage reimbursement and IRS mileage log](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/mileage-reimbursement/): Price each trip at the IRS mileage rate in force on its date (2026: 72.5 cents to June 30, 76 cents from July 1; medical, moving, charity and GSA rates too), apply Announcement 2026-11's paid-date rule to employer allowances, total a payroll trip sheet per employee with the true-up owed and the W-2 split above the federal rate, and make an IRS-ready vehicle-year log with a Publication 463 completeness check.
- [Minimum wage lookup by address](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/minimum-wage-lookup/): The legal minimum wage and tipped cash wage at a US work address, ZIP code or city on any date: the highest of the federal, state, county and city rates, which government sets it, since when, and the next scheduled change, each rate with the official page it was read from and the date. Employer-size tiers, regional state rates (New York, Oregon) and unincorporated county areas are handled; cities and states whose pages could not be read are listed as not covered, never guessed. Also lists every known change in a date window.
- [Name tag generator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/name-tag-generator/): Turn an RSVP list (CSV, Excel or rows) into print-ready name badges at the exact positions of Avery badge templates 5395, 5895, 5390, 5392, 5146 and 5147 (and every number Avery lists as compatible, such as 8395 or 74459), each name fitted as large as it can be, with a start label for part-used sheets, spare blanks, a check-in list, a free alignment test page and single walk-in badges.
- [Ontario rent increase calculator (N1)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/ontario-rent-increase/): The most an Ontario rent can rise to (1.9% for 2027, 2.1% for 2026), the earliest date under the 12-month rule, the last day to serve Form N1 by hand or by mail (90 days, mail counts from the fifth day), the November 15, 2018 exemption check, and the interest and top-up on a last month's rent deposit, each with its section of the Residential Tenancies Act.
- [Overtime auditor for timesheet CSVs](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/overtime-auditor/): Audit a timesheet export (many employees, many weeks, punches or hours) for the regular, overtime and double-time hours owed under the federal weekly rule and the California (daily, double time, seventh day, alternative workweek), Alaska, Colorado and Kentucky rules, flag the weeks payroll underpaid, and total the FLSA-only premium for W-2 box 12, code TT.
- [Pay application and retainage (G702/G703-style)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/pay-application/): Build this month's pay application from the schedule of values: work from previous applications, this period and stored materials, change orders, retainage (flat, per line, separate on stored materials, or reduced at a percent complete), previous certificates and the amount due, with the tie-out checks a GC runs and a G702/G703-style PDF and CSV; plus retainage calculators (forward, reverse, change orders, release) and state retainage limits quoted from the statutes.
- [Deposit and milestone payment schedule](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/payment-schedule/): Split a project fee into a deposit and milestone payments (50/50, 50/25/25, 30/30/40 or your own) to the cent, with invoice and due dates on business days, invoice-ready lines for every stage, a final invoice that nets off what was already paid, a calendar file, and the California, Maryland, Maine and Florida home-improvement deposit rules.
- [Payout reconciliation: split a payout into sales, refunds, fees and tax](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/payout-reconciliation/): Upload the payout export from Stripe, Shopify Payments, PayPal or Square and get each payout split into sales, refunds, chargebacks, fees, tax on fees, reserves and adjustments that add up to the deposit to the cent, with a balanced journal through a clearing account and an import file for QuickBooks Online or Xero.
- [PTO and sick leave accrual by state](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/pto-accrual/): Runs one employee's PTO policy bank and the state or city paid sick leave bank side by side, paycheck by paycheck: hours earned per hour worked or per pay period, the yearly and balance caps, the waiting period, year-end carryover and what is forfeited; the payout owed at separation with the state's vacation rule; hours per pay period for an annual PTO amount; and each covered place's rules quoted from its own statute or agency page with the date read. Places we could not read are listed as not covered.
- [QR code generator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/qr-code-generator/): Static QR codes that never expire, for links, WiFi, contact cards, email, text messages, calls and map locations: every file is read back before you get it and shows the exact text it holds. Make a whole batch from a spreadsheet as a ZIP and a label sheet, and check whether a code you already printed goes through a vendor that can switch it off.

## About

- [Tools](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/tools/): Every live tool by category, with what it does and its price per use in words.
- [Pricing](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/pricing/): Free use, yearly plans for firms and teams, credit packs for agents and code with prices per 1,000 answers, passes for people, every live tool's price in words, how a charge works, and common questions.
- [How it works](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/how-it-works/): Top up once, use any tool on the web, over REST or over MCP, and pay per use from one balance.
- [Developers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/developers/): The REST API: a quickstart with real requests and responses, API keys, errors, idempotency keys, rate limits, quotes and the OpenAPI document.
- [MCP for AI agents](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/developers/mcp/): Ground an AI agent in exact figures: where a guessed number goes wrong, then connect over MCP by address, sign-in or an API key, the tools it lists, quote\_price and example calls.
- [Why exact](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/why-exact/): Exact answers versus AI guesses, with worked examples from the tools: observed holidays, substitute days, weekend exchange rates and holiday delivery dates.
- [About](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/about/): Who makes the tools and how they work: Conyso Holdings, exact tools for specific jobs, no AI in the answers.
- [Who it's for](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/): The tools grouped by who uses them, with a page for each kind of work.
- [Photo credits](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/photo-credits/): Every image on the site, where it came from and its licence.
- [For firms and ops teams](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/teams/): For firms and ops teams: what each kind of firm uses the tools for, connecting an AI agent in three steps, the yearly plans, and how data is handled.
- [Data handling and paperwork](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trust/): The data-handling sheet (what is stored and for how long), security questionnaire answers, and the paperwork: tax forms, data processing terms and invoices.
- [For freelancers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/freelancers/): For freelancers and the self-employed: tax set-aside per payment, an IRS mileage log, exchange rates on a date and business-day due dates.
- [For truckers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/truckers/): For owner-operator truckers: the year's per diem worksheet at the IRS transportation rate, and tax set-aside per settlement.
- [For bookkeepers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/bookkeepers/): For bookkeepers and tax preparers: 1099 thresholds with an IRIS file, payroll mileage at the IRS rate by date, per diem worksheets, set-aside and exchange rates.
- [For online sellers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/online-sellers/): For online sellers: delivery and holiday order-by dates, business-day handling times, photos under an upload size and exchange rates on a date.
- [For tax preparers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/tax-preparers/): For tax preparers and enrolled agents: per diem worksheets, mileage logs, 1099 scans and set-aside numbers to check and file from.
- [For gig drivers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/gig-drivers/): For rideshare and delivery drivers: tax set-aside per payout with miles and tips, and miles at the IRS rate with a mileage log.
- [For real estate agents](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/real-estate-agents/): For real estate agents: tax set-aside per commission check, a mileage log at the IRS rate, and contract deadlines in business days.
- [For nonprofits](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/nonprofits/): For nonprofit treasurers and bookkeepers: mileage at the IRS business and charity rates, and 1099 scans with an IRIS file.
- [For payroll and HR](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/payroll-and-hr/): For payroll and HR: mileage reimbursement sheets at the IRS rate by date, and dates in business days.
- [For small business owners](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/small-business-owners/): For small business owners: 1099 scans for contractors with an IRIS file, and mileage at the IRS rate by date.
- [For landlords](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/landlords/): For landlords and property managers: security deposit deadlines and letters by state, 1099s for contractors, and mileage at the IRS rate.
- [Para conductores](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/es/para/conductores/): En español, para conductores de viajes y entregas: cuánto apartar para impuestos de cada pago, con millas y propinas, y las millas a la tarifa del IRS con un registro de millaje.
- [Status](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/status/): Each live tool's last check and 90 days of recorded checks, measured from inside the server.
- [Docs](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/docs): How to call the tools from code: REST and MCP, authentication, errors, idempotency and limits.
- [Privacy](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/privacy): What Endwise stores about visitors and accounts, in plain words.
- [Terms of service](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/terms/): The terms for using Endwise: accounts and keys, the prepaid balance, prices, refunds, acceptable use and liability.
- [Refunds and cancellation](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/refunds/): What Endwise refunds automatically, how to get unused money back, and how to close an account.
- [Acceptable use](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/acceptable-use/): What Endwise may not be used for.
- [Security](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/security/): How Endwise protects accounts, keys and balances, and how to report a vulnerability.
- [Contact](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/contact/): How to reach Endwise for support, billing, privacy and security.
